name: Rochor Fringe
summary: Fringe of Rochor / Little India toward Bencoolen — DTL/NEL adjacency with arts-school energy and denser central living without full Orchard gloss.
body: Rochor Fringe is the shortlist when arts-campus walkability and dual-line adjacency matter more than mall-spine living. The pocket sits on the Rochor / Bencoolen / Little India edges; housing mixes mid-age condos with selective walk-ups. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and culture nights. Watch-outs: weekend tourist spill, street noise variance, and estate tank/booster notice culture. Compare with Bras Basah for museum-campus core, Lavender South for EWL mid-town, and Kallang Wave when stadium living wins.
bestFor: renters comparing Rochor vs Bencoolen edges
housingMix: Mid-age condos and walk-ups with selective serviced edges.
commuteNotes: Downtown / North-East Line gravity via Rochor / Little India / Bencoolen depending on block. Walk a Sunday afternoon before you LOI.
